title: Related section on the Reference detail
description:
components/needs-me-reference-detail.tsx, beside ReferenceConversation (design section 6):
- Header "Related" (Link icon). Concepts as chips (Hash icon + #hashtag). Suggested chips: Sparkles icon + the word "Suggested" + "close match 0.81" as text + the S2.8 control.
- References as cards: title, host, "published <date> · added <date>" ("published unknown" when null), edge type in words.
- Add: one textarea "Type # for a concept, or paste a link or a title"; results as full-width buttons below it (vector + prefix search over concept_card, reference_summary, exact sourceUri match). Pressing one writes a current human edge.
- "Suggest more" button (Sparkles) calls suggestReferenceLinks.
- Without a vector index: lists confirmed links, accepts exact hashtags, and says "Suggestions need the knowledge index".
Screenshot review with Ryan before merge.
UI rules: Lucide icons; buttons + textarea, no dropdowns or popovers; one Accept/Reject vocabulary; a text label beside every mark (never colour alone); no AppSync subscriptions; screenshot review by Ryan on a local dev server before merging.
